statement: Every n-vertex Laman graph that is planar as an abstract graph has a generic real realization whose edge lengths admit at least 2^(n−2) real realization classes.
scope: Abstract planar Laman graphs, n≥3; the realizations themselves may cross; reflected realizations are distinct.
notes: The source identifies reflections and counts 2^(n−3); generic noncollinearity doubles this under the catalogue convention.
